notes: r3 investigator pass, owner-delegated verdict. Sparse two-skin LiDAR cloud (~0.25 pts/mm2 per skin; t 1.5 mm from skin pairs; outer bend radius ~2.2 mm so Ri ~0.8). Six real 90 deg formed folds, established from per-plane maps and perpendicular sections, none missed: F1 tall wall|strip, F2 strip|mid wall, F3 mid wall|base (4-segment stair, s 239.5..527), wall|tab (s 439.5..475.5), wall|end flange (two coplanar segments with a 10 mm relief gap) and wall|diagonal corner flange. Run margin 12 mm (wide support zone for the sparse cloud), small flanges 28 mm.
